## Batch 42 authored

Added a local trace-quotient lemma that reconciles the matrix map’s \(H^1/H_0^1\) data with batch 41’s fixed-atlas \(H^{1/2}\) convention. Updated the matrix definition, open-problem formulation, A/B pages, manifest, contracts, coverage, and cross-batch evidence.

The trace lemma records Gagliardo’s trace characterization and Kampanou’s trace and extension theorems; both relevant passages were fetched and inspected ([Gagliardo](https://www.numdam.org/item/RSMUP_1957__27__284_0.pdf), [Kampanou](https://pergamos.lib.uoa.gr/uoa/dl/object/2864871/file.pdf)). The open problem remains escalated because the 2026 preprint claims its conclusion, but I have not independently validated the proof.

Key artifacts: [trace-quotient lemma](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-ip-euclidean-trace-quotient-is-h12.md), [open-problem item](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/op-ip-general-anisotropic-calderon-uniqueness.md), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-42.proof-contracts.json), and [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-42.notes.md).

## Checks and blockers

- Proof contracts: 6/6 items, no errors or warnings. Proof layout: 6 items, 20 steps, no defects. Focused dependency and content-policy checks passed. Source fetch: 7/7 verified.
- Coverage checklist: 0 errors, with one low-yield warning asking Alpha to confirm declined results.
- Native Step 1 records could not be written: `step1-decisions.mjs record` fails loading the run with `Duplicate item undefined`, caused by string-only item entries on the unassigned batch-67 page. No records were created.
- The run also has the existing owner-repair blocker and batch cycle `74 -> 75 -> 74`; I left engine state and unassigned files unchanged. The global cross-batch ledger check also encounters ambiguous ownership of `lem-seifert-matrices-of-a-knot-are-s-equivalent` across batches.

The current batch-41 bodies and contracts were checked, but remain draft; no acceptance is inferred.
